title: wikiwikibangbang
author: Atlas core
description: Use a wikiwikibangbang wiki from a process: open a task for a person, read it, change its title, properties and labels, move it through its workflow, comment on it and find tasks by a query; create a page, read it as Markdown and append to it. A model names the Worker and the operation; the wiki's base URL and the API token of a technical account live in the Worker and the vault and reach only the worker (ADR-draft-wikiwikibangbang-worker). The account is an editor in the spaces processes write to; an account with a system role is refused. An item reaches a process as one flat object — id, key, type, space, parent, title, state, properties, labels and version, and its body on Read item. With a matching field a create answers with the item an earlier round made instead of making a second; a transition whose target state the item already stands in succeeds; an append carries every block of the page back unchanged. A missing or unreadable item carries the code WIKIWIKIBANGBANG_ITEM_NOT_FOUND and a value the wiki refuses the code WIKIWIKIBANGBANG_VALIDATION_FAILED, each thrown as a BPMN error when the process catches it.

properties.label: Worker
properties.description: Name of the configured wikiwikibangbang Worker (Console → Workers) whose wiki the task writes to, never a credential. The attribute behind this field is spelled connector like its siblings'.

properties.label: Item (all but create and query)
properties.description: The item by its id or its key (OPS-12), e.g. =aufgabe.id. Keep the id: a key changes when the item moves to another space.

properties.label: Space (create)
properties.description: The space's key, e.g. OPS. The Worker's account needs the role editor there.

properties.label: Item type (create)
properties.description: The type's name, e.g. task — a type with a workflow for a task, a type with a body for a page.

properties.label: Parent (create)
properties.description: Optional. The item to place the new one under, by its id or key.

properties.label: Title (create, update)
properties.description: The item's title; optional on update.

properties.label: Properties (create, update)
properties.description: A JSON object of property values by the field's name, as the item's type defines them, e.g. {"assignee": "=antrag.besitzer", "due": "=antrag.faellig"}. A string starting with = is a FEEL expression. null changes nothing, "" unsets.

properties.label: Properties variable (create, update)
properties.description: Instead of the values above: a process variable holding the properties object.

properties.label: Matching field (create)
properties.description: Optional. The property that identifies the item, e.g. source-id: an item of this type in this space with the value the properties set is answered instead of a second one.

properties.label: Labels (update)
properties.description: Optional. Replaces the item's labels: a comma-separated list, or a FEEL list; an empty list clears them.

properties.label: Text (create, append)
properties.description: Plain text: an empty line starts a new paragraph, a single line break stays inside its paragraph. On append, it is added at the end of the page.

properties.label: Blocks (create, append)
properties.description: Instead of text: the wiki's blocks as a JSON list or a FEEL list, for headings, lists, tables or panels, e.g. [{"kind": "heading", "level": 2, "text": "Protokoll"}].

properties.label: Transition (move)
properties.description: The transition's name, e.g. finish. If the item already stands in the state it leads to, the task succeeds.

properties.label: Comment (comment)
properties.description: The comment, as plain text, written as the Worker's account.

properties.label: Query (query)
properties.description: A query in the wiki's query language, e.g. type = task AND assignee = currentUser() AND state != done ORDER BY due.

properties.label: Maximum results (query)
properties.description: More matches fail the task rather than return a short list; default 100, at most 1000.

properties.label: Result variable
properties.description: Receives the item, the list of items, the comment or the page's Markdown. Required on Read item, Read page and Query items.
